PDF Fast Isosurface Extraction Methods for Large Image Data sets
In this chapter, we discuss three techniques developed by the authors (and colleagues) for fast isosurface extraction for large-scale imaging datasets. The first technique is the near optimal isosurface extraction (NOISE) algorithm for rapidly extracting isosurfaces.
